description:
About our brand and products:
COBI is a European manufacturer of high-quality construction brick models designed primarily for adults and collectors. Our portfolio includes officially licensed sets inspired by military history, aviation, armored vehicles, and classic automotive icons. All COBI bricks are manufactured in the European Union using premium materials and feature durable printed details instead of stickers, delivering a more authentic and long-lasting building experience.

What makes us different:
COBI focuses on historical accuracy, premium quality, and a collector-grade experience. Our sets are developed with strong attention to detail and often created in cooperation with museums, historians, and licensed partners such as Boeing, Lockheed Martin, Maserati, Jeep, and others. Unlike many other brick brands, COBI produces all elements in the EU and uses high-quality prints rather than stickers, making our models especially appealing to adult hobbyists and military history enthusiasts.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn a commission on every qualifying purchase made through their referral links. Our broad catalog of models, frequent new releases, and strong interest from collectors create consistent opportunities for conversions. We also regularly run promotions and product launches that affiliates can leverage to drive additional traffic and sales.

How to promote us:
COBI products perform especially well with audiences interested in military history, aviation, model building, engineering, and collector hobbies. Affiliates can promote our sets through product reviews, build videos, comparison content, social media posts, blog articles, newsletters, and curated gift guides. Visual content showing the building process or the finished models tends to resonate strongly with our audience.

Other information:
We continuously expand our product range with new releases and licensed collaborations throughout the year. Affiliates receive access to official product assets, updates about upcoming launches, and promotional opportunities tied to major product releases and seasonal campaigns. Our goal is to build long-term partnerships with creators and publishers who share our passion for history, engineering, and high-quality model building.
